title: A banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not!
question: Did you know a banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not?
answer: To plant scientists, a banana is a true berry because its seeds grow inside its soft flesh, but a strawberry is not a true berry because its seeds sit on the outside.

visual.what: A big yellow banana and a red strawberry stand side by side on a table, each with a glowing question mark above. The banana wears a tiny gold crown labeled BERRY.

parts.text: Did you know a banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not?

visual.what: Mai, hands on her cheeks, looks at the banana and strawberry. Her thought bubble shows the two fruits swapped places.

parts.text: I know! Let me show you.

visual.what: A simple flower with the ovary at the bottom highlighted and labeled OVARY. An arrow points from it to a soft round fruit.

parts.text: Botanists are people who study plants. They say a berry is a soft fruit that grows from one part of a flower, called the ovary.

visual.what: A banana cut across, showing soft flesh with seeds inside. Beside it, a grape and a tomato, each with a small green tick.

parts.text: In a true berry, the seeds are inside the soft flesh. A banana fits! So do grapes and tomatoes.

visual.what: A big close-up of a strawberry with its tiny seeds on the outside skin. A red cross sits next to it.

parts.text: Wait, the strawberry seeds are on the outside!
Yes! They look like seeds on the outside. But the real reason is that the red part does not grow from the ovary.

visual.what: A strawberry with arrows. One arrow points to a tiny dot labeled A TINY FRUIT WITH A SEED INSIDE. Another points to the red part labeled GROWS FROM ANOTHER PART OF THE FLOWER.

parts.text: Each little dot is really a tiny fruit with a seed inside. And the red part grows from a different part of the flower.

visual.what: Huy holds up a banana in one hand and a strawberry in the other. Mai cheers beside him and a Follow button pops up on the screen.

parts.text: So plant words are tricky! Follow Ask Huy for more wow facts.

facts.claim: A banana is botanically a berry.
Botanists mean a simple fruit made from a single ovary when they say berry, and the seeds are inside the soft part.
Grapes and tomatoes are true berries, and bananas are true berries even though they have no berry in their name.
On a real berry the seeds are inside the fruit, but on a strawberry the seeds are on the outside, so it is not a berry.
Botanically the strawberry is not a berry but an aggregate accessory fruit, and each apparent seed on the outside is an achene, a fruit with a seed inside.
The fleshy part of a strawberry comes from the receptacle, not the ovary.
In everyday speech, many fruits called berries are not berries to botanists.
